# ADR-3056: A05: Cloud metadata exposure path for workload 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

SSRF to metadata yields cloud credentials.

## Decision

Workloads SHALL NOT expose a cloud metadata exposure path for workload 8 (A05-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

IMDSv2 and egress controls are is expected to.
